item.title: Coachella Valley Students Shine at Riverside County Science and Engineering Fair, Top Winners Advance to State and International Competition
item.description: Students from across the Coachella Valley put their innovation and research skills on display at the Riverside County Science and Engineering Fair, held Friday at the Riverside Convention Center.The event featured 530 students from throughout Riverside County presenting 367 research projects across 22 different subject categories. item.title: Cabot’s Pueblo Museum Hosts Free Mata Ortiz Pottery Festival with Live Demonstrations and Auction
item.description: Cabot's Pueblo Museum is hosting a special cultural event this weekend featuring award-winning artists from Mata Ortiz. The free event began today and runs through Sunday, offering visitors a rare chance to see master potters demonstrate traditional techniques passed down through generations.Guests can watch artisans create pottery entirely by hand, without modern tools or equipment. item.title: Trilby Tatro On A Plate
item.description: Trilby Tatro, executive chef of Wildest Restaurant & Bar, cooks us a delicious uni pasta, talks all about her love of fresh local ingredients, her match made in heaven with business partner Charissa Farley, and shares how her mother's love of food paved the way for own culinary journey. This is Trilby Tatro on a plate. For more Coachella Valley News visit NBCPalmSprings.com

item.title: La Quinta Concerts in the Park Continues with Free Live Music at SilverRock Park
item.description: The La Quinta Concerts in the Park series continues tomorrow night, bringing free live music and community fun back to the Coachella Valley.The concert will take place at SilverRock Park and will feature the band Chico, performing a mix of Latin oldies and R&B favorites. item.title: Palm Springs Man Searching for Stolen Dog Dash, 4-Year-Old Black Shepherd Taken from Andreas Hills Yard
item.description: A Palm Springs man is asking for help after his dog was taken from his front yard earlier this week.Gary says his dog Dash, a 4-year-old black shepherd, was taken from the Andreas Hills area of Palm Springs. He describes Dash as sweet-natured, friendly and comfortable around strangers.Since Dash went missing, Gary has contacted police, notified local animal shelters and organized search efforts that included drones and volunteers.
